<section class="page" id="page-start" data-page="start" aria-label="Startseite">
 <div class="hero">
  <img class="hero-image" data-asset="hero" alt="Eine mediterrane Tapas-Tafel mit kleinen Tonschalen, frischem Brot und Wein im warmen Abendlicht" fetchpriority="high">
  <div class="wrap hero-inner"><div class="hero-content"><div class="eyebrow">Buenas noches. Schön, dass du da bist.</div><h1 tabindex="-1" aria-label="Tippi Toppi Tappas"><span>Tippi Toppi</span><span><em>Tappas.</em></span></h1><p class="hero-tagline">Ein bisschen Spanien.<br>Ganz viel Lebensfreude.</p><p class="hero-description">Entdecke mediterrane Köstlichkeiten, gute Weine und unvergessliche Abende in geselliger Atmosphäre.</p><div class="hero-actions"><a class="btn" href="#reservieren">Tisch reservieren <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></a><a class="btn outline" href="#speisekarte">Speisekarte entdecken <svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-arrow"/></svg></a></div></div></div>
  <div class="hero-seal" aria-hidden="true"><svg><use href="#i-sun"/></svg><span>Kleine Teller.</span><span>Große Gefühle.</span></div>
  <div class="wrap hero-bottom"><a class="scroll-cue" href="#willkommen" data-scroll="willkommen"><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-down"/></svg>Ein Abend voller Möglichkeiten</a><span>Tapas · Vino · Buena vida</span></div>
 </div>
 <div class="wrap intro-strip"><div><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-leaf"/></svg>Mediterran inspiriert</div><div><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-wine"/></svg>Zum Teilen gemacht</div><div><svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-heart"/></svg>Von Herzen Gastgeber</div></div>
 <div class="section wrap welcome-grid" id="willkommen">
  <div class="welcome-visual reveal"><img data-asset="interior" alt="Illustration eines warm beleuchteten mediterranen Restaurantinterieurs mit Naturmaterialien" loading="lazy"><div class="image-note">Ein kleiner Urlaub.<br>Ein großer Genuss.<small>Bienvenidos a la mesa</small></div></div>
  <div class="welcome-copy reveal"><div class="eyebrow accent">Schön, dass du hier bist</div><h2>Willkommen bei<br>Tippi Toppi Tappas.</h2><p class="body-copy">Ein Tisch voller kleiner Köstlichkeiten. Ein Glas Wein, das den Abend einläutet. const GALLERY=[
{image:'interior',name:'Ein Platz zum Wohlfühlen',category:'Unser Restaurant',alt:'Illustratives mediterranes Interieur mit warmem Licht und Naturmaterialien'},
{image:'gambas',name:'Knoblauch. Chili. Glück.',category:'Unsere Tapas',alt:'Gambas al Ajillo in einer rustikalen Tonschale'},
{image:'wirt',name:'Unser Gastgeber Stefan Schmitz',category:'Unser Team',alt:'Stefan Schmitz mit einem Glas Wein im Restaurant',original:true},
{image:'terrace',name:'Wenn der Abend länger wird',category:'Mediterrane Momente',alt:'Illustrative mediterrane Terrasse im Abendlicht'},
{image:'patatas',name:'Knusprig verliebt',category:'Unsere Tapas',alt:'Knusprige Patatas Bravas mit Sauce'},
{image:'bar',name:'Herzlich willkommen an der Bar',category:'Unser Team',alt:'Das Team an der Bar von Tippi Toppi Tappas',original:true},
{image:'platter',name:'Am liebsten von allem etwas',category:'Unsere Tapas',alt:'Eine bunte mediterrane Tapas-Platte mit verschiedenen Spezialitäten'},
{image:'hero',name:'Ein Tisch voller Lebensfreude',category:'Mediterrane Momente',alt:'Eine mediterrane Tapas-Tafel mit Wein und kleinen Köstlichkeiten'},
{image:'service',name:'Die Menschen hinter dem Abend',category:'Unser Team',alt:'Ein Mitarbeiter des Serviceteams im Restaurant',original:true},
{image:'pimientos',name:'Ganz einfach. Einfach gut.',category:'Unsere Tapas',alt:'Grüne gebratene Pimientos de Padrón mit Meersalz'},
{image:'koch1',name:'Mit Liebe zubereitet',category:'Unser Team',alt:'Ein Mitglied des Küchenteams bereitet Speisen zu',original:true},
{image:'churros',name:'Das süße Finale',category:'Unsere Tapas',alt:'Goldbraune Churros mit Schokoladensauce'},
{image:'koch2',name:'Mittendrin in unserer Küche',category:'Unser Team',alt:'Ein Koch bei der Arbeit am Herd im Restaurant',original:true}
];
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>Array.from(document.querySelectorAll(s));
const euro=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat('de-DE',{style:'currency',currency:'EUR'}).format(n);
const reducedMotion=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)');
const icon=(name)=>'<svg class="icon" aria-hidden="true"><use href="#i-'+name+'"/></svg>';
const imageAlt=key=>({gambas:'Illustrativer Serviervorschlag: Gambas al Ajillo',patatas:'Illustrativer Serviervorschlag: Patatas Bravas',pimientos:'Illustrativer Serviervorschlag: mediterrane grüne Paprika',platter:'Illustrative mediterrane Tapas-Auswahl',churros:'Illustrativer Dessert-Serviervorschlag mit Churros',hero:'Illustrative mediterrane Tapas-Tafel mit Getränken'}[key]||'Mediterraner Serviervorschlag');
$$('[data-asset]').forEach(img=>{img.src=ASSETS[img.dataset.asset]});
$('.skip').addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();$('#main').focus();$('#main').scrollIntoView({behavior:'instant'});});
$('#copyright-year').textContent=new Date().getFullYear();
let menuCategory='Alle',galleryCategory='Alle',galleryVisible=GALLERY.slice(),galleryIndex=0,persons=2,selectedTime='',pendingBooking=null,dialogOpener=null;
const allowedRoutes=['start','speisekarte','galerie','ueber-uns','reservieren','kontakt','impressum','datenschutz'];
function closeMobile(){const button=$('#menu-toggle');button.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');button.setAttribute('aria-label','Menü öffnen');$('#mobile-nav').hidden=true;}
$('#menu-toggle').addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=$('#menu-toggle').getAttribute('aria-expanded')==='true';$('#menu-toggle').setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(!open));$('#menu-toggle').setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Menü öffnen':'Menü schließen');$('#mobile-nav').hidden=open;});
document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'&&!$('#mobile-nav').hidden){closeMobile();$('#menu-toggle').focus();}});
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(!$('#mobile-nav').hidden&&!event.target.closest('.site-header'))closeMobile();});
window.matchMedia('(min-width: 901px)').addEventListener('change',event=>{if(event.matches)closeMobile()});
function showPage(focus=true){let route=location.hash.slice(1)||'start';if(!allowedRoutes.includes(route)){route='start';history.replaceState(null,'','#start');}$$('.page').forEach(page=>page.hidden=page.dataset.page!==route);$$('.nav-link,.header-reserve,#mobile-nav .btn').forEach(link=>{if(link.getAttribute('href')==='#'+route)link.setAttribute('aria-current','page');else link.removeAttribute('aria-current');});closeMobile();$$('dialog[open]').forEach(dialog=>dialog.close());window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'instant'});const titles={start:'Ein bisschen Spanien.',speisekarte:'Speisekarte',galerie:'Galerie','ueber-uns':'Über uns',reservieren:'Tisch reservieren',kontakt:'Kontakt',impressum:'Impressum · Demo',datenschutz:'Datenschutz · Demo'};document.title='Tippi Toppi Tappas · '+titles[route];if(focus){const heading=$('#page-'+route+' h1');if(heading)heading.focus({preventScroll:true});}observeReveals();updateScroll();if(route==='reservieren')refreshDateTimes();}
window.addEventListener('hashchange',()=>showPage());
document.addEventListener('click',event=>{const scrollLink=event.target.closest('[data-scroll]');if(scrollLink){event.preventDefault();const target=document.getElementById(scrollLink.dataset.scroll);target.scrollIntoView({behavior:reducedMotion.matches?'instant':'smooth'});}const sameLink=event.target.closest('a[href^="#"]');if(sameLink&&!sameLink.dataset.scroll&&sameLink.getAttribute('href')===location.hash){closeMobile();window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:reducedMotion.matches?'instant':'smooth'});}});
let revealObserver=null;
function observeReveals(){if(reducedMotion.matches||!('IntersectionObserver'in window)){ $$('.reveal').forEach(el=>el.classList.remove('pending'));return;}if(!revealObserver)revealObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.remove('pending');revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);}}),{threshold:.08});$$('.page:not([hidden]) .reveal:not([data-observed])').forEach(el=>{el.dataset.observed='true';el.classList.add('pending');revealObserver.observe(el);});}
function updateScroll(){const max=document.documentElement.scrollHeight-window.innerHeight;$('#scroll-progress').style.width=(max>0?Math.min(100,window.scrollY/max*100):0)+'%';$('#to-top').hidden=window.scrollY<500;}
let ticking=false;window.addEventListener('scroll',()=>{if(!ticking){requestAnimationFrame(()=>{updateScroll();ticking=false;});ticking=true;}},{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',updateScroll);$('#to-top').addEventListener('click',()=>window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:reducedMotion.matches?'instant':'smooth'}));
function makeDishCard(dish){const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='dish-card';button.dataset.dish=dish.id;button.setAttribute('aria-label',dish.name+', '+euro(dish.price)+'. Details ansehen');button.innerHTML='<span class="dish-visual"><img loading="lazy"><span class="dish-plus" aria-hidden="true">+</span></span><span class="dish-info"><span class="dish-title-row"><span class="dish-name"></span><span class="dish-price"></span></span><span class="dish-description"></span>'+(dish.veg?'<span class="dish-label">'+icon('leaf')+'Vegetarisch</span>':'')+'</span>';button.querySelector('img').src=ASSETS[dish.image];button.querySelector('img').alt=imageAlt(dish.image);button.querySelector('.dish-name').textContent=dish.name;button.querySelector('.dish-price').textContent=euro(dish.price);button.querySelector('.dish-description').textContent=dish.description;button.addEventListener('click',()=>openDish(dish,button));return button;}
['gambas','patatas','pimientos','platte'].forEach(id=>$('#highlights-grid').append(makeDishCard(MENU.find(dish=>dish.id===id))));
function createFilters(container,labels,callback){labels.forEach((label,index)=>{const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='filter-btn';button.textContent=label;button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(index===0));button.addEventListener('click',()=>{container.querySelectorAll('button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===button)));callback(label);});container.append(button);});}
function normalized(value){return value.normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLocaleLowerCase('de-DE').trim();}
function renderMenu(){const search=normalized($('#menu-search').value);const dishes=MENU.filter(dish=>(menuCategory==='Alle'||dish.category===menuCategory)&&normalized(dish.name).includes(search));$('#menu-grid').replaceChildren(...dishes.map(makeDishCard));$('#menu-empty').hidden=dishes.length>0;$('#menu-count').textContent=dishes.length+' '+(dishes.length===1?'Genussmoment':'Genussmomente')+(menuCategory!=='Alle'?' · '+menuCategory:' · für deinen Abend');}
createFilters($('#menu-filters'),['Alle',...CATEGORIES],category=>{menuCategory=category;renderMenu();});$('#menu-search').addEventListener('input',renderMenu);$('#menu-reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{menuCategory='Alle';$('#menu-search').value='';$('#menu-filters').querySelectorAll('button').forEach((button,index)=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(index===0)));renderMenu();$('#menu-search').focus();});renderMenu();
function openDialog(dialog,opener){dialogOpener=opener||document.activeElement;document.body.classList.add('modal-open');dialog.showModal();}
$$('dialog').forEach(dialog=>{dialog.querySelectorAll('[data-close]').forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>dialog.close()));dialog.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.target===dialog){const rect=dialog.getBoundingClientRect();if(event.clientX<rect.left||event.clientX>rect.right||event.clientY<rect.top||event.clientY>rect.bottom)dialog.close();}});dialog.addEventListener('close',()=>{document.body.classList.remove('modal-open');if(dialogOpener&&dialogOpener.isConnected&&dialogOpener.getClientRects().length)dialogOpener.focus({preventScroll:true});if(dialog.id==='booking-dialog'){pendingBooking=null;$('#booking-summary').replaceChildren();}});});
function openDish(dish,opener){$('#dish-dialog-title').textContent=dish.name;$('#dish-dialog-description').textContent=dish.description;$('#dish-dialog-price').textContent=euro(dish.price)+' · Demo';$('#dish-dialog-image').src=ASSETS[dish.image];$('#dish-dialog-image').alt=imageAlt(dish.image);$('#dish-dialog-vegetarian').hidden=!dish.veg;openDialog($('#dish-dialog'),opener);}
$('#dish-reserve').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#dish-dialog').close());
function renderGallery(){galleryVisible=GALLERY.filter(item=>galleryCategory==='Alle'||item.category===galleryCategory);$('#gallery-grid').replaceChildren(...galleryVisible.map((item,index)=>{const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='gallery-card';button.setAttribute('aria-label',item.name+' – Bild vergrößern');button.innerHTML='<span class="gallery-img"><img loading="lazy"></span><span class="gallery-caption"><span></span><small></small></span>';const img=button.querySelector('img');img.src=ASSETS[item.image];img.alt=item.alt;button.querySelector('.gallery-caption>span').textContent=item.name;button.querySelector('small').textContent=item.original?'Originalfoto':'KI-Illustration';button.addEventListener('click',()=>{galleryIndex=index;renderLightbox();openDialog($('#gallery-dialog'),button);});return button;}));}
createFilters($('#gallery-filters'),['Alle','Unser Restaurant','Unsere Tapas','Mediterrane Momente','Unser Team'],category=>{galleryCategory=category;renderGallery();});renderGallery();
function renderLightbox(){const item=galleryVisible[galleryIndex];$('#lightbox-image').src=ASSETS[item.image];$('#lightbox-image').alt=item.alt;$('#lightbox-title').textContent=item.name;$('#lightbox-source').textContent=item.original?'Originalfoto aus dem bereitgestellten Ordner Bilder':'KI-generierte Food- oder Ambienteillustration · Gestaltungsvorschlag';$('#lightbox-count').textContent=(galleryIndex+1)+' / '+galleryVisible.length;}
function stepGallery(amount){galleryIndex=(galleryIndex+amount+galleryVisible.length)%galleryVisible.length;renderLightbox();}$('#gallery-prev').addEventListener('click',()=>stepGallery(-1));$('#gallery-next').addEventListener('click',()=>stepGallery(1));$('#gallery-dialog').addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='ArrowLeft'){event.preventDefault();stepGallery(-1);}if(event.key==='ArrowRight'){event.preventDefault();stepGallery(1);}});
const TIMES=['17:00','17:30','18:00','18:30','19:00','19:30','20:00','20:30','21:00'];
function localDate(date=new Date()){return date.getFullYear()+'-'+String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-'+String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');}
function validDate(value){if(!/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(value))return false;const date=new Date(value+'T12:00:00');return !Number.isNaN(date.getTime())&&localDate(date)===value;}
function timeIsPast(date,time){return date===localDate()&&new Date(date+'T'+time+':00')<=new Date();}
TIMES.forEach(time=>{const button=document.createElement('button');button.type='button';button.className='time-option';button.textContent=time;button.dataset.time=time;button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');button.addEventListener('click',()=>{selectedTime=time;$$('.time-option').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(b===button)));$('#error-time').textContent='';});$('#time-options').append(button);});
function refreshDateTimes(){const today=localDate();$('#booking-date').min=today;const date=$('#booking-date').value;$$('.time-option').forEach(button=>{button.disabled=!!date&&(date<today||timeIsPast(date,button.dataset.time));if(button.disabled&&selectedTime===button.dataset.time){selectedTime='';button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false');}});}
$('#booking-date').addEventListener('change',()=>{refreshDateTimes();clearError('date');});
function updatePersons(){ $('#persons-value').textContent=persons+(persons===1?' Person':' Personen');$('#persons-minus').disabled=persons<=1;$('#persons-plus').disabled=persons>=12;}
$('#persons-minus').addEventListener('click',()=>{persons=Math.max(1,persons-1);updatePersons();});$('#persons-plus').addEventListener('click',()=>{persons=Math.min(12,persons+1);updatePersons();});updatePersons();refreshDateTimes();
function clearError(field){$('#error-'+field).textContent='';$('#booking-'+field).removeAttribute('aria-invalid');}
['name','phone','email'].forEach(field=>$('#booking-'+field).addEventListener('input',()=>clearError(field)));
function setError(field,message){$('#error-'+field).textContent=message;const input=$('#booking-'+field);if(input)input.setAttribute('aria-invalid','true');}
function bookingErrors(){const data={date:$('#booking-date').value,time:selectedTime,persons,name:$('#booking-name').value.trim(),phone:$('#booking-phone').value.trim(),email:$('#booking-email').value.trim(),wishes:$('#booking-wishes').value.trim()};const errors={};if(!validDate(data.date))errors.date='Bitte wähle ein gültiges Datum.';else if(data.date<localDate())errors.date='Bitte wähle heute oder einen Tag in der Zukunft.';if(!TIMES.includes(data.time))errors.time='Bitte wähle eine Uhrzeit aus.';else if(validDate(data.date)&&timeIsPast(data.date,data.time))errors.time='Diese Uhrzeit ist bereits vergangen. Bitte wähle eine spätere Zeit.';if(data.name.length<2||!/[\p{L}]/u.test(data.name))errors.name='Bitte gib deinen Namen mit mindestens zwei Zeichen ein.';const digits=data.phone.replace(/\D/g,'');if(!/^\+?[0-9 ()/.-]+$/.test(data.phone)||digits.length<7||digits.length>15)errors.phone='Bitte gib eine gültige Telefonnummer mit 7 bis 15 Ziffern ein.';if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@.]+(?:\.[^\s@.]+)+$/.test(data.email))errors.email='Bitte gib eine gültige E-Mail-Adresse ein.';return {data,errors};}
function addSummaryRow(label,value){const row=document.createElement('div');row.className='review-row';const dt=document.createElement('dt');dt.textContent=label;const dd=document.createElement('dd');dd.textContent=value;row.append(dt,dd);$('#booking-summary').append(row);}
$('#booking-form').addEventListener('submit',event=>{event.preventDefault();refreshDateTimes();['date','name','phone','email'].forEach(clearError);$('#error-time').textContent='';const {data,errors}=bookingErrors();Object.entries(errors).forEach(([field,message])=>setError(field,message));$('#form-alert').hidden=Object.keys(errors).length===0;if(Object.keys(errors).length){const first=Object.keys(errors)[0];const element=first==='time'?$('.time-option:not(:disabled)'):$('#booking-'+first);if(element)element.focus();return;}pendingBooking=data;$('#booking-dialog-title').innerHTML='Ein schöner Abend<br>in der Vorschau.';$('#booking-review').hidden=false;$('#booking-success').hidden=true;$('#booking-summary').replaceChildren();const date=new Date(data.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('de-DE',{weekday:'long',day:'numeric',month:'long',year:'numeric'});addSummaryRow('Datum',date);addSummaryRow('Uhrzeit',data.time+' Uhr · Demo-Zeit');addSummaryRow('Personen',String(data.persons));addSummaryRow('Name',data.name);addSummaryRow('Telefon',data.phone);addSummaryRow('E-Mail',data.email);if(data.wishes)addSummaryRow('Wünsche',data.wishes);openDialog($('#booking-dialog'),$('#booking-form .submit'));});
$('#edit-booking').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#booking-dialog').close());
$('#confirm-demo').addEventListener('click',()=>{if(!pendingBooking)return;if(pendingBooking.date<localDate()||timeIsPast(pendingBooking.date,pendingBooking.time)){$('#booking-dialog').close();setError('time','Der gewählte Termin ist inzwischen vergangen. Bitte wähle erneut.');$('#form-alert').hidden=false;refreshDateTimes();return;}const random=new Uint32Array(1);window.crypto.getRandomValues(random);$('#reservation-number').textContent='DEMO-TTT-'+Date.now().toString(36).toUpperCase()+'-'+random[0].toString(36).slice(0,4).toUpperCase();$('#booking-dialog-title').textContent='Hasta pronto – in der Demo!';$('#booking-review').hidden=true;$('#booking-success').hidden=false;pendingBooking=null;$('#booking-summary').replaceChildren();$('#booking-form').reset();persons=2;selectedTime='';$$('.time-option').forEach(button=>button.setAttribute('aria-pressed','false'));updatePersons();refreshDateTimes();$('#booking-dialog-title').setAttribute('tabindex','-1');$('#booking-dialog-title').focus();});
$('#finish-booking').addEventListener('click',()=>$('#booking-dialog').close());
window.addEventListener('focus',refreshDateTimes);document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(!document.hidden)refreshDateTimes();});
showPage(false);
</script>
</body>
</html>
